explanation_full: The model performance evaluation indicates that the KNN model achieved the best performance with an R2 score of 0.83014, utilizing 9 features. This suggests that the combination of features leading to this set provides the most robust predictive power. Complementing this, the correlation analysis highlights that Butyrate and VFA exhibit the strongest correlation (0.9601), suggesting that these two metabolites are highly co-varying and likely contribute significantly to the model's predictive success.
